description: Boundary coverage for environment credential token encoding. Covers the partial-credential paths the native suite omits (only the user name supplied, or only the password supplied) which both report the neutral missing-credentials error, plus payloads with characters that exercise JSON escaping and the URL-safe Base64 alphabet (quotes, backslashes, non-ASCII, and bytes that map to the URL-safe '-'/'_' symbols). Output is either the encoded token or the neutral error line.
